integrity: General proof is algebraic and combinatorial. Verifier exhausts only prime fields of orders 3 and 5. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled structure tables, not isomorphism classes; only odd finite fields, two-dimensional commutative possibly nonassociative algebras. Historical equivalent formulations cannot be excluded.
title: Exact finite-field census of perfect idempotent-free binary commutative algebras
